config.study_status: prespecified after exploratory analysis; test days previously inspected
config.feature_contract: nonnegative finite float32, little endian, signed zero canonicalized
config.sample_method: bottom-k SplitMix64 priority of source file ordinal and CSV row index, independent of values
config.fit_weight: population stratum count / sampled stratum count, then class balancing by population class totals

operating_point.rule: strictly above normal order statistic, preserve ties, no test tuning

config.hyperparameter_selection: none; all fixed families are reported
config.uncertainty: paired UTC-day block bootstrap only if >=8 observed test days; otherwise descriptive leave-one-day-out, no CI

temporal_protocol.selection_rule: Keep candidates with >=1000 rows in every required_support_field; sort ascending by common-test start (B_cal_end_utc), calibration_hours, B_added_fit_hours, candidate_id; select first. This rule is fixed after metadata exploration and before any new training/predictions.

flow_boundary_enforcement.lower_boundary_rule: ts >= interval_start + 60, except collection_start with no added gap
flow_boundary_enforcement.upper_boundary_rule: ts < interval_end - 60 and ts + raw_duration < interval_end - 60, except collection_end_exclusive with no subtracted gap; even at collection end flow must end strictly before endpoint
flow_boundary_enforcement.invalid_timestamp_or_duration: exclude and count; raw feature contract remains mandatory
flow_boundary_enforcement.crossing_flow_policy: exclude entire row, do not truncate duration or move to another role
flow_boundary_enforcement.failure_action: stop before training if any atomic role A_fit/A_cal/B_fit_added/B_cal/common_test has fewer than1000 rows of either class; do not silently relax or change split
flow_boundary_enforcement.claim: observed flow interval containment and 60-second margins; session/host/campaign independence is not established

temporal_protocol.B_fit_rule: union of A_fit and B_fit_added; all A_cal and B_cal rows remain excluded from both fitting versions
temporal_protocol.duplicate_policy: retain recurrent feature vectors in primary temporal population; compute counts and tagged known/new-to-fitting subsets; do not delete future records merely because same 8D vector occurs in fit; conflicting labels retained
interpretation_limits: No candidate contains all four common-test groups. Selected C0014 has no attack known to A in common test, so its subgroup estimate is undefined, never zero recall. C0026 has known-A test attacks but no added-B test attacks.
Attack type is considered known for fitting only if retained fitting rows of that type remain after all gates/subsampling; audit changes from pre-purge coverage.
Training should retain the complete source-type coverage; if resource sampling drops a rare type, report and gate or preserve that type via a frozen stratified sampler.
A/B calibration periods have different attack mixtures (injection vs DDoS), so effects include calibration distribution change.
Fixed60-second gaps do not prove independent sessions; flow start/end metadata alone cannot establish host/campaign independence.
Small B-calibration normal support(2102 prepurge) limits FPR precision; do not promise a target FPR on future data.
Previously reported full-collection exploratory model scores must not be called an untouched test.

evaluation.frequency_weight_definition: each vector gets total weight1 (cap100: min(n,100)); conflicting labels retain proportional shares, never majority relabeled; subgroup weights use full-test vector frequency
evaluation.raw_vector_exposure_definition: exact 8-feature float32 vectors in full eligible fit/calibration populations, including rows not sampled for fitting; primary test retains all repetitions
